supersession_reason: Before any rolling comparison output was computed, clarified that trade observations must have been received before each feature cutoff to qualify as as-of inputs. Version 1 was frozen and committed but never executed.

scope.question: How closely does a dashboard-style OHLCV volume-spreading approximation reproduce a trade-price-bin profile on the same bounded windows?
scope.evidence_tier: bounded, exploratory source-consistency/profile-method comparison on already inspected data
not_a_test_of: generalization to other symbols, days, regimes or exchanges

instrument_and_sources.venue_product: Bitget USDT-FUTURES AAPLUSDT stock-referenced perpetual; derivative trades/candles, not listed-equity trades
instrument_and_sources.quote_settlement: USDT (instrument settlement metadata is not revalidated by this comparison)

trade_source.provider: CryptoHFTData third-party normalized Bitget futures archive
trade_source.clock: trade_time in UTC epoch milliseconds controls event-window inclusion; received_time in nanoseconds is reported separately for availability. event_time is checked against trade_time, not silently substituted.
trade_source.coverage_status: Observed receive-hour objects, not a complete exchange-ledger certificate

candle_source.base_volume: saved base_volume column (Bitget candle response field 6)
candle_source.quote_volume: retained but not used to weight the profile
candle_source.coverage_status: 12 saved same-hour bars; source agreement for these bars is checked per rolling window

windows.window_rule: At boundary t, the as-of trade profile uses trades with trade_time in [t-15m,t) AND received_time < t*1,000,000 ns, plus exactly the three saved, contiguous 5m candles covering that interval for the candidate candle estimate. Trades in the event-time interval received at or after t are counted as late/unavailable and excluded from the as-of trade profile; any such row makes that window NOT_COMPARABLE. Windows overlap by 10 minutes.
windows.causality: Trade features use only event-time observations strictly before t that the third-party collector records as received strictly before t. Saved historical candle publication/availability time is unknown; therefore candle-side and end-to-end live decision-time causality are not established. The comparison is an as-of trade-source diagnostic with a retrospective completed-candle approximation.
windows.missing_or_invalid_window: Keep a window disposition with source mismatch/insufficient status; never fill missing trades or bars with zero. Do not silently drop it from denominators.

input_validation.trade_rows: Validate every row in the three named receive-hour objects for AAPLUSDT, integer nonnegative IDs/timestamps, finite positive Decimal price/quantity, and received_time in nanoseconds. Compare event_time with trade_time; any mismatch in the three objects blocks shape comparison for the run and is reported, not silently repaired.
input_validation.trade_identity: Deduplicate only identical repeated trade_id rows with matching event_time, trade_time, received_time, symbol, price, quantity and provider flags. Conflicting repeats block shape comparison for the run. Report duplicate and conflict counts.
input_validation.trade_partition_use: Read all rows from all three receive-hour objects, then select by event-time trade_time; do not use receive-hour partition as an event-time filter. Report selected as-of and late/unavailable row counts by receive-hour object.
input_validation.candles: Require exactly one AAPLUSDT row at each expected 5m open timestamp in [14:00,15:00), with ordered OHLC, nonnegative base volume, no duplicates, and no missing cadence. Any failure blocks shape metrics for affected windows and remains in the output.
input_validation.window_consistency: For each window, require exactly three contiguous 5m candles, at least one as-of trade, zero late/unavailable event-time trades, and exact as-of trade-versus-candle high, low, close and base-volume equality before comparing profile shapes. Any failure blocks shape metrics for affected windows and remains in the output; no rows or bars are synthesized.

common_profile_definition.weight_unit: base asset quantity (AAPL-perpetual contract quantity as recorded by the provider); no quote-notional weighting
common_profile_definition.price_range: For each window independently, common low=min(trade prices, three candle lows), common high=max(trade prices, three candle highs). Record whether trade extrema equal candle extrema.
common_profile_definition.edges: Equal-width common range; bins are half-open [edge_i,edge_i+1), except final bin includes the maximum. A flat range is a degenerate window and is non-estimable.
common_profile_definition.trade_profile: Place each as-of-available observed trade's base quantity entirely in the bin containing its exact trade price. Validate all source numeric values and preserve decimal strings/Decimal arithmetic; do not round prices or quantities before binning.
common_profile_definition.candle_approximation: Aggregate the three completed 5m candles into one 15m OHLCV candle: first 5m open, max high, min low, last close, sum base volume. Spread its base volume uniformly over its high-low price span by overlap with each of the same 24 common bins, matching dist/orderbook.js volumeProfile's range-weighting algorithm. If high=low, put the entire bar volume in the containing bin.
common_profile_definition.volume_gate: For shape comparison, require exact equality of observed trade base quantity and summed candle base_volume and equality of trade-vs-candle high/low/close for each window. If not exact, report the discrepancy and mark profile shape metrics NOT_COMPARABLE for that window; no normalization is used to conceal a coverage mismatch.
common_profile_definition.profile_normalization: For shape metrics only, divide each comparable profile's bins by its own total base quantity after the exact volume gate. Also preserve raw bin quantities and total volumes.
common_profile_definition.poc: Maximum-volume bin; ties choose the lowest-price bin. Report bin center and normalized displacement in basis points of the common-range midpoint.
common_profile_definition.value_area: Start with POC and add one adjacent bin with greater quantity until cumulative quantity is at least 70% of profile total. A tie chooses the lower-price adjacent bin; include intervening bins. Report inclusive bin bounds, price bounds and realized fraction.
common_profile_definition.hvn_candidates: Interior strict local maxima only: central bin exceeds both immediate neighbors and is at least 1.5 times their mean. No smoothing; thresholds are fixed protocol choices, not validated market conventions.
common_profile_definition.lvn_candidates: Interior strict local minima only: central bin is below both immediate neighbors and no more than 0.5 times their mean. No smoothing; thresholds are fixed protocol choices, not validated market conventions.
common_profile_definition.node_match: For cross-source HVN/LVN precision/recall/F1, match node bin indices exactly within the common window. Do not tune a price tolerance after viewing results. If either node set is empty, report both sets and counts but leave precision/recall/F1 undefined rather than assigning a favorable score.

profile_change_descriptors.scope: All nine adjacent rolling-window transitions only; overlapping windows are highly dependent and are not independent replications. If either window is not comparable, retain the transition with its non-comparable reason.
profile_change_descriptors.poc_move: Difference in POC bin-center price in bps of the prior window midpoint, computed separately for trade and candle profiles.
profile_change_descriptors.poc_move_agreement: Report same-sign/zero-sign agreement and absolute difference between the two POC moves; no inferential test.
profile_change_descriptors.normalized_profile_turnover: For each source separately, one half the sum of absolute changes in normalized 24-bin quantities by bin index between adjacent comparable windows. Since each window's price range may change, this is a coarse descriptor, not a price-aligned or predictive feature result.
profile_change_descriptors.value_area_overlap: Price-interval intersection length divided by union length for consecutive windows, separately by source.
profile_change_descriptors.node_change: Counts of newly appearing and disappearing HVN/LVN bin indices between adjacent windows, separately by source; changing ranges mean bin indices are window-relative, so this is a coarse descriptor only.

primary_method_fidelity: late/unavailable event-time trade counts by window and receive-hour object
trade-versus-candle base-volume differences and OHLC source-consistency status
exact POC-bin agreement and absolute POC displacement in bps
normalized 24-bin profile total-variation distance and Pearson correlation when defined
70% VA price-interval overlap and lower/upper boundary displacement
HVN/LVN candidate counts and exact-bin precision/recall/F1, with empty-node cases explicit
comparison_outputs.baseline: The trade-at-price profile is the observed descriptive reference; the candidate estimator is 15m OHLCV uniformly spread across each candle's range. There is no signal, no-return or trading baseline because no outcome is evaluated.
comparison_outputs.uncertainty: No p-values, confidence intervals, bootstrap or significance claims; ten overlapping windows on one symbol/hour are not independent evidence.

preexisting_inspection_disclosure: The same AAPL hour was previously used for trade OHLCV/VWAP and an ex-post 20-bin profile; its 12 same-hour 5m candle comparisons and open discrepancy were inspected. The specific rolling 24-bin agreement results and node/turnover metrics had not been computed at freeze time. This is prospectively frozen for a new exploratory diagnostic, not preregistered or fresh holdout evidence.

reproduction.raw_files: Session-local only; no raw Parquet is committed. A fresh bounded acquisition can use research.chd_sample with the three named receive-hour objects.

limitations: A public trade print is an observation; exact source volume agreement on this selected sample is not an independent completeness certificate.
A 15m bar reconstructed from three saved 5m bars is not a separately fetched native Bitget 15m response. Its OHLCV aggregate is explicitly a 5m-derived proxy for the dashboard's OHLCV approximation.
Binned trade quantity is not a complete trade-at-price ledger and bin resolution changes the profile.
One symbol, one hour, one date and ten overlapping windows cannot establish stable profile behavior or predictive value.
Current Bitget stock-perpetual reference mappings/sessions are not historical equity-market evidence.
No costs, returns, entry, fills, portfolio, performance or strategy efficacy are evaluated.
